news.title: Tate Brothers Arrested in Miami As U.K. Authorities File Sex Crime Charges
news.summary: Federal marshals arrested the influencers, who are known for their misogynistic views and have faced years of criminal investigations in Europe. The new charges concern offenses dating to 2010, British officials said.
